features.name: Use the own Colt Cobra family silhouette printed25/PDF27: compact boxlike receiver, short front muzzle at right, curved magazine BEHIND the pistol grip/trigger toward the rear stock (bullpup ordering), forward pistol grip and rounded rectangular trigger opening. Preserve the source-shown compact rear stock element.
All three variants retain the folding stock; the family illustration does not label a TZ subtype or establish a unique stock deployment for each variant.
Top-mounted laser sight replaces the basic gas-vent system; folding stock retained. Do not include both standard gas vent and replacement laser as the stock package.

Root inspected the prepared overlay against the single accepted raw pair. Paired silhouette and landmarks remain aligned; each source mask retains its own components/openings, with no discarded components or filled holes. Thin members and structural openings retained. Fine grooves/seams are nonblocking. Native1254 images retained;2048 is resampled, not native2K. Root reviewed actual CobraTZ115 detail/clay against own ColtCobra family artwork Arsenal printed25/PDF27 and source-audit-v2. Rear folding-stock element,curved magazine behind the single main grip,forward trigger opening and continuous receiver underside follow source;invented second front handgrip is removed. TZ115 retains top-mounted laser and plain short muzzle replacing standard gas-vent attachment; no added barrel gas vent. Family art does not independently label subtype-specific stock deployment;exact finish,laser housing detail and hidden depth artistic. Clay preserves major boundaries,raised controls and intentional openings;shallow channels,fine vents and tiny fasteners are nonblocking under latest user instruction. Genuine alpha,full positive margins,no floor/cast shadow. Alpha diagnostics distinguish sub-floor bright edge pixels from actual structure;no corrective cosmetic calls required. Native1254square originals retained,2048 resampled,not native2K.
